reviews.title: I like it
reviews.comment: I love it, it’s sturdy and reliable. Didn’t have issues installing it. Loved the wire compartment. Value for money is great. Coming to the ease if movement, from time to time you need to tighten the joints. Especially because i use it a lot. So it becomes lose. But it’s fine.
reviews.author: Ali Radwani

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.comment: I got this for the MV6 gaming microphone and it is a perfect match. The magnetic tops let's you pull off the top and you can tuck the wire into the frame itself. Very sturdy! No sagging
reviews.author: The Mad Villain

reviews.title: Don’t buy this
reviews.comment: Do not buy this. Getting the joint tight enough to hold up the microphone (Shure MV7) is nearly impossible and, one tight, it doesn’t hold. The ball join that allows you to adjust microphone position is cheap and difficult to adjust at best. Good idea and nice price but you’ll get what you pay for and it isn’t worth it.
reviews.author: Disappointed buyer

reviews.title: You cannot go wrong with this at all!!
reviews.comment: 3/18/25 All I can say is that I am a HUGE FAN of this boom, mic arm.  It is nice and clean, moves with such ease - no GLIDES!  It gives my desk the clean look I wanted to maintain versus the standard swing arms that are super clunky.  I like the added attention to detail with having a nice magnetic bar that pops right off to hide the cord from the mic instead of those cumbersome plastic cap covers. I had debated on whether to purchase this item or not, seriously who spends that much for such a basic item...it was more than worth it!  It is a natural fit for my SHURE mic as well.  I could not be more pleased unless the stand was given to me for free! (Laughing) Go ahead and make yourself happy as well.  You deserve something that is as nice as this that keeps your desk clutter free and allows you to move the mic easily into the position you desire.
reviews.author: Sandra D.
